effects: Sets the signer's GTC delegate to `delegatee`, replacing any earlier delegate.
Moves the signer's whole current GTC vote weight from the old delegate to `delegatee`. Later balance changes follow the new delegate.
Uses up the signer's shared nonce. It must equal nonces[signer], the same counter that permit uses.
Anyone can submit the signature until `expiry`. After that time it is rejected.
No tokens, allowances or native value move.
formats.shown: "Delegate GTC voting power". Below it: the delegatee as a raw hex address, the nonce as a plain integer, and the expiry as a raw Unix timestamp (1798761600).

findings.title: Delegation: expiry is shown as a raw Unix timestamp, not as a date.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json field {"path":"expiry","label":"Expiry","format":"raw"}. Case 0 shows Expiry "1798761600". GTC.sol delegateBySig: require(now <= expiry, ...) treats it as a timestamp in seconds.

findings.title: Delegation: no interpolated intent, so the sentence does not say who gets the voting power.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json intent "Delegate GTC voting power", interpolatedIntent absent. GTC.sol _delegate: delegates[delegator] = delegatee; _moveDelegates(currentDelegate, delegatee, delegatorBalance).
findings.fix: Add "interpolatedIntent": "Delegate all GTC voting power to {delegatee}".

findings.title: Delegation: the delegatee address is shown raw, with no ENS or name lookup.
Delegation: the intent does not say that this replaces the current delegate and moves the signer's whole balance.
findings.evidence: GTC.sol _delegate: address currentDelegate = delegates[delegator]; ... _moveDelegates(currentDelegate, delegatee, delegatorBalance). The intent reads "Delegate GTC voting power". This replacement is what delegate means (not_critical #12).
findings.fix: Optional wording: "Delegate all your GTC voting power to {delegatee} (replaces current delegate)".

findings.title: Delegation: the nonce is shown as a field, which adds clutter but no meaning for the signer.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json field {"path":"nonce","label":"Nonce","format":"raw"}. GTC.sol delegateBySig: require(nonce == nonces[signatory]++, ...).
findings.fix: Optionally set the nonce field to "visible": "never" or "optional".

findings.title: Delegation: the test and file name say 'GTK token', but the token is GTC (Gitcoin).
findings.evidence: cases/0.json "description": "GTK token". File name eip712-tally-ethereum-gtk-token.json. GTC.sol: string public constant symbol = "GTC".
findings.fix: Rename the description and file to GTC.

cases.notes: Synthetic EIP-712 case with no mined transaction. Judged from code: the domain (name Gitcoin, chainId 1, verifyingContract) and the type string match DOMAIN_TYPEHASH and DELEGATION_TYPEHASH in GTC.sol. The delegatee is shown correctly. The expiry is shown only as a raw timestamp.
